This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
Do you enjoy a work culture and environment where you can see your career developing? Are you excited to join one of the leaders in the IT world?
We are a hands-on DevOps group supporting both on-prem and cloud environments for our flagship product – Xclarity One.
Our focus is reliability, security, and developer productivity.
 What You Will Do
Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows across multiple environments. 
Operate and enhance containerized infrastructure and orchestration platforms. 
Implement and maintain monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices. 
Strengthen platform security and access controls in build and runtime environments. 
Create and maintain clear documentation, runbooks, and handover notes. 
Collaborate with engineering and QA to unblock delivery and improve developer productivity. 
Contribute to planning and execution for releases and platform improvements. 
Automate repetitive operational tasks to increase reliability and speed. 
Automate cloud infrastructure provisioning and changes using infrastructure-as-code and policy guardrails. 
Embed DevSecOps practices across the SDLC, integrating security scanning and controls into pipelines and runtime. 
You collaborate cross-functionally with data scientists, business users, project managers and other engineers to achieve elegant solutions. 
 What You Will Bring
At least 5 years of hands-on Linux experience and scripting for automation and troubleshooting. 
Solid experience with CI/CD systems and artifact registries. Experience upgrading or maintaining build servers is a plus. 
Proficiency with containers and Kubernetes in at least one major cloud provider and comfort adapting workflows for on-prem environments. 
Strong infrastructure-as-code skills, including hands-on experience with Terraform, and proficiency in configuration management. 
Practical knowledge of monitoring and alerting stacks and email or webhook integrations. 
Working understanding of cloud identity, secrets management, and least-privilege access patterns. 
Experience troubleshooting across the stack and writing clear, reproducible documentation and runbooks. 
 Nice To Have
GitOps tooling such as ArgoCD. On-prem packaging and deployment patterns 
Experience defining or reporting DORA metrics and reliability KPIs. 
Prior contributions to security and compliance practices in CI/CD or runtime. 
Familiarity with Microsoft Azure services and cloud governance best practices. 
Bachelor of Computer Science or similar
